notes.title: Demo closed for new downloads!
notes.content:
[p][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]The public demo for LANESPLIT is now officially closed as I begin working on major changes and optimizations based on your feedback.[/p][p]Concerns were raised about high CPU and memory usage, and I have already reworked key systems like the map loading to improve performance for all users drastically! [/p][p]
Closed playtests will begin soon and will be announced first on our [url="https://discord.gg/vaJArsEKDW" buttoncolor="#ad37fb"]Discord[/url]
[/p][p]Thank you to everyone who tried the demo and for the feedback![/p][p]– FunkyMouse :)[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Demo Launches TOMORROW!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,
The Early Access Demo for Lanesplit goes live tomorrow!

This is a [b]single-player-only[/b] preview of LANESPLIT. It’s still in development and will be unpolished, with missing features and rough edges — but it should give you a taste of what LANESPLIT is all about.

[u] Spotted a bug? Got ideas or suggestions?[/u]
Please join the Discord and let me know: [url=https://discord.gg/vaJArsEKDW]DISCORD[/url]

[u] A few important things to keep in mind:[/u]
- This demo does not include multiplayer
- It’s an early access build, so expect bugs, placeholders, and rough edges
- Everything is subject to change as development continues

Thanks for giving LANESPLIT a spin — your feedback means everything and will help shape where it goes from here :)

– FunkyMouse

notes.title: Quick Update on Lanesplit
notes.content:
[u][b]Quick Update on Lanesplit 🛣️[/b][/u]
Hey everyone! 
I just wanted to give a heads-up that there’s a bit of a delay in Lanesplit’s release.
 I have been running into some annoying issues with the multiplayer setup (because, of course, networking never makes things easy ), however, they have now been sorted out and preparation is underway for a playtest sometime in Q2 (hopefully by May!) 
Thanks for your patience while I squash these bugs. More news soon! :)
- FunkyMouse
